title: Independence
body: India becomes independent; the Constituent Assembly continues to draft the Constitution.

title: The Constitution comes into force
body: India becomes a republic. The date is celebrated as Republic Day.

title: First general election begins
body: Held from October 1951 to February 1952, with universal adult franchise.

title: The Emergency is declared
body: Civil liberties are suspended until March 1977.

title: First non-Congress government
body: Morarji Desai of the Janata Party becomes Prime Minister.

title: National Front government
body: V. P. Singh of the Janata Dal becomes Prime Minister of a coalition government.

title: Economic liberalisation
body: The Union Budget opens up the economy (P. V. Narasimha Rao government, Finance Minister Manmohan Singh).

title: Panchayati Raj in the Constitution
body: The 73rd Amendment comes into force, giving village councils constitutional status.

title: Right to Information Act in force
body: Any citizen can ask a public authority for information.

title: Women's reservation becomes law
body: One-third of Lok Sabha and assembly seats are to be reserved for women after the next delimitation.
